environment.description: EC2 instance (i-0a3f7c2e9b1d4e5f6) running the reporting monolith in us-east-1. LaunchDarkly SDK key configured but the 'report-engine-v2' flag does not exist in the project (returns default value 'false'). Application is exposed via classic ELB on port 8080 with no request filtering. Instance profile has broad S3 and SSM access. JDK 11, Spring Boot 2.5.4.
